snippet.title: Taskmaker 00 Tutorial
snippet.description:
Taskmaker is a 90's Mac shareware game that, as a child, I played the living hell out of. A while ago I found out you can actually still purchase legit unlock codes from the developer for 10 dollars, which I was more than happy to do (again). Unfortunately right when I was getting started playing it is when my old 1st generation iMac decided to crap out on me (Bravo though, that thing lasted forever). I finally got some Mac Classic emulation set up and had to start a new Taskmaker game.

You can still purchase Storm Impact's whole suite of things here:
http://www.robotroom.com/StormImpact.html
